ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Download from Office Domain
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious ways to download files from Microsoft domains that are used to store attachments in Emails or OneNote documents

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wget\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-WebRequest.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*iwr\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*curl\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wget\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Start\\-BitsTransfer.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadFile\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadString\\(.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/attachment\\\.outlook\\\.live\\\.net\\/owa\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/onenoteonlinesync\\\.onenote\\\.com\\/onenoteonlinesync\\/.*")))
